summary: Iter35 — Re-verification of the 4 iter34 bugs on the Camo Cash connect/create-vault flow + full regression on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). HUGE wins on 3 of 4: (1) wallet-other-toggle (data-testid='wallet-other-toggle') now EXISTS, text 'Other wallets · not ZK-native', expands to show Phantom/Solflare/Backpack rows with Install links on both desktop and mobile ✓. (2) Create button in create-wallet sheet now matches spec exactly: computed backgroundColor=rgb(244,244,245) + color=rgb(8,9,12) ✓. (3) CRITICAL CRASH FIXED: 'Open Camo Cash' no longer navigates to the 'This page couldn\'t load' error view — it opens the wallet dashboard with header 'Camo Cash Wallet · <shortaddr>', balance card, tokens, anonymity set 686, etc. ZERO 'insertBefore / appendChild / removeChild' DOM mutation exceptions in the console across the full flow (desktop + mobile) ✓. Recovery key still starts with camosk2 ✓ (e.g. camosk22vJkxRkenDznovcHQrmJ6dZVCehxQWuLNzqttmuKAUQxS9ZztS). cc-tagline is correctly HIDDEN after a wallet connects (desktop + mobile) ✓. Receive page shows full camo2-prefixed address (camo266vZ8X2JtRJf6TBqjwgrwL4GEQ7ntKAf4fsRVmpXZY9NVmU5SyRPkBBwSqHUnzuNjZypzNcM4c2) + QR code renders ✓. cc-dock-chain testid rename landed (old cc-dock-dk:chain gone) ✓. TWO issues remain: (A) 'Minimum 10 characters.' hint is STILL missing from the password sheet — spec #5 was supposed to inject this via paraphrase.json but no text containing 'Minimum 10' / '10 characters' appears in the sheet before or after typing. (B) NEW regression from the clone-based wallet grouping: the original upstream Phantom / Solflare / Backpack cards are STILL VISIBLE outside the 'Other wallets' dropdown — i.e. when the dropdown is COLLAPSED you can see all 3 wallet cards sitting below it; when EXPANDED you see 6 (3 clones inside dropdown + 3 originals outside). The .wg-has-ext hide rule in camo-theme.css is NOT taking effect against the upstream cards. Reproduced on both desktop 1920 and mobile 390.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Minimum 10 characters.' hint is STILL MISSING. Searched for 'Minimum 10 characters', 'Minimum 10', '10 characters' — none present before or after typing a password. paraphrase.json entry may exist but no overlay rule injects it near the password field. Sheet currently reads: 'Set up · takes 10 seconds / Open your private vault. ... Password for this device / Repeat it / It opens Camo Cash on this browser only. It can't be reset, but your recovery key can restore everything.' — the required min-length hint is absent.

Clone-based wallet grouping is leaking: the ORIGINAL upstream Phantom/Solflare/Backpack cards remain visible OUTSIDE the dropdown. In collapsed state the sheet shows: Camo Wallet, 'Other wallets · not ZK-native' toggle (collapsed), then 3 full Phantom/Solflare/Backpack cards (the originals that should be CSS-hidden). In expanded state 6 wallet rows appear (3 clones inside + 3 originals outside). .wg-has-ext hide rule from camo-theme.css is not matching, or the parent group container isn't getting the .wg-has-ext class applied when upstream siblings exist. Repro on both 1920 desktop and 390 mobile.

issues: Toast 'Copy failed: open Receive to copy it by hand' shows when clicking Copy address — expected in headless iframe context (clipboard API blocked). Minor; may want to use document.execCommand fallback or hide copy-fail toast when not interactive.

action_items: FIX: inject 'Minimum 10 characters.' hint below the password input in the create-wallet sheet. Confirm the paraphrase.json entry is wired to an overlay insertion (camo-app.js fixCreateCopy) and actually fires on sheet mount.

FIX: ensure the .wg-has-ext class (or equivalent) is applied to the parent wallet group container as soon as clones are injected, so the hide rule in camo-theme.css covers the original Phantom/Solflare/Backpack cards. Alternatively, directly set display:none / visibility:hidden on the upstream originals when cloning. Verify duplicates disappear on both desktop and mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: ensureWalletGroup() clone-based approach fixes the crash but introduces a visual duplication regression. The 'hide originals via CSS' contract depends on a specific class being applied to the parent container — if that class application is conditional on upstream rendering timing (React re-render after overlay runs), the clones will show side-by-side with originals until a re-render fires. Make the hide operation idempotent and apply directly to the original nodes (inline style) rather than relying on an ancestor class.

Password hint injection: paraphrase.json is a declarative source of truth but the actual DOM injection code path should log a warning when it fails to locate the target element — currently silent regressions like this 'Minimum 10 characters.' miss are only caught by UI tests.

Positive: ensureTagline as a body-level fixed badge + hide-when-wallet-connected is a clean fix — no more React DOM contention, confirmed zero insertBefore/appendChild/removeChild exceptions across the full create → open flow.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — 6 of 8 verified spec items pass; 2 fail (password hint + duplicate wallet cards)

seed_data_creation: None. No orders placed, no funds moved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two remaining bugs on the connect/create flow: (1) 'Minimum 10 characters.' password hint still missing — overlay rule for paraphrase.json entry not firing; (2) upstream Phantom/Solflare/Backpack cards duplicated outside the 'Other wallets' dropdown — .wg-has-ext hide rule not applied / originals not hidden. Everything else from iter34's bug list is confirmed FIXED: wallet-other-toggle exists & expands, Create button is light-bg/dark-text rgb(244,244,245)/rgb(8,9,12), 'Open Camo Cash' no longer crashes and opens dashboard, header shows 'Camo Cash Wallet · …', cc-tagline hidden on connect, Receive shows camo2… full address + QR, recovery key camosk2 prefix OK, cc-dock-chain testid renamed, ZERO DOM mutation exceptions. Repro env: desktop 1920 + mobile 390, both show the same 2 remaining bugs.
rca of the issue: (1) Missing hint: paraphrase.json presumably contains 'Minimum 10 characters.' key but camo-app.js fixCreateCopy either doesn't look up this key or doesn't have an injection target selector that matches the current React-rendered password sheet. Add a defensive lookup + log; place the hint element as sibling of the first password input. (2) Duplicate wallets: ensureWalletGroup clones upstream .wopt nodes INTO the dropdown but the hiding mechanism (.wg-has-ext on parent) is not actually applied — either the parent-class assignment runs before React mounts the originals and never re-runs, or the CSS selector targets the wrong ancestor. Fix: when cloning, directly set the ORIGINAL node's style.display='none' (idempotent, survives React re-renders because overlay re-runs on mutation observer). This mirrors the clone-based pattern already working for the tagline.
